page.layout: One page of running text in one column; running head at top centre with page number at top right; a centred word-spaced line "FINIS" below the text. No margin notes.

main_text.l: adimi voluit, eo ipso iure manere in se
animo patiatur, ut regula iuris edicit:

page.notes: Printed text is mostly clear. The 'FINIS' line is set in spaced capitals and is given as a list line, not a heading. Hyphenated line-end "libe-rabat" and "a-nimo" are written whole as "liberabat" and "animo" because the printed hyphen is a line-end break; the words are reconstructed from context and the scan is slightly blurred at the line ends, so "liberabat" and "animo" should be checked. The printed "Quinto" after "Marcus" and "Quinto" in "deniq;" are both as printed. The ligature in "Quinto" (Qu) and the abbreviation "q;" are kept as printed.
